rpc_ownership.rationale: 2,846 tokens already have event+graph+micro+execution and lack only ownership. Launch-day BQ partitions were already scanned. Re-parsing archival getTransaction pre/post token balances for existing Pump trade signatures yields genuine SPL ownership edges without BQ cost.

N_100k.reason: Same as N_25k: plan has no per-mint unit costs for full rich groups.

N_25k.reason: FUSION_EXPANSION_COST_PLAN covers ownership recovery for the existing rich subset gap (2,846 ownership-only mints → ~3,132 fusion overlap), not per-group cost/time to build microstructure/ownership/graph/wallet_prior for N=25k new mints.

N_all_broad_train_val.reason: No frozen unit-cost model for expanding all rich groups to the full broad train+val mint set; plan is ownership-backfill scoped.

why_rich_count.note_3623: 4000 rich-subset mints total; 3623 appear in train+val observation assignments (377 test mints excluded from analysis).

selection.policy: Stratified sample by launch day × mayhem × holder tertile × buy tertile using only pre-T launch fields; graduation is post-hoc composition only; Jul 3 outage day excluded; capped at max_mints=4000; deterministic mint rank.
